general.meritName: No automatic tier found; competitive holistic scholarships only
general.dl: Nov 15, 2026 priority (Honors College); accelerated-MD app due Jan 15, 2027
general.note: “Accelerated Undergraduate to M.D. Program” (BARSC-M.D.), confirmed active for 2026-27 with fewer than 10 students selected per cohort. Invitation-only within the Honors College: students must first be admitted to USC AND the Honors College (deadline Nov 15, 2026), and only the most competitive of those are invited (~late Dec 2026) to apply to the accelerated track (closes Jan 15, 2027). No residency restriction found, unlike several similar programs at other schools.
general.medNote: Not a program you apply to directly — being a strong Honors College admit is the real gatekeeper here.
